categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Canlon Building Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of new building waterproof materials and provides waterproof engineering construction services. Its product portfolio includes waterproof membranes and coatings, widely applied in residential buildings, infrastructure such as railways, subways, highways, airports, water conservancy, and utility tunnels. The company also operates in industrial roofing, photovoltaic roofing systems, and related construction services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company focuses on advanced polymer waterproof materials including TPO and PVC membranes, self-adhesive polymer membranes, and composite steel-plastic panels. It has developed proprietary formulas and production equipment for high-performance waterproof membranes with certifications like EU CE, REACH, UK BBA, US FM, and SGS. Production methods emphasize order-based manufacturing with forward sales forecasting, continuous formula optimization, and process innovation to improve quality, cost, and delivery.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include large real estate developers, infrastructure construction companies, industrial building owners, and distributors across China. The company serves markets in residential construction, urban renewal projects, infrastructure such as rail transit and highways, industrial roofing, and photovoltaic power generation. Export markets include the US, UK, Norway, Singapore, Australia, and Egypt.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with a nationwide sales and distribution network covering major prefecture-level cities. It has production bases and subsidiaries in multiple provinces including Jiangsu, Hebei, Hubei, Sichuan, Guangxi, and Anhui. Export sales extend to multiple international markets including North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and Australia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Canlon operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying waterproof materials. It also provides downstream waterproof engineering construction services. The company sources raw materials such as asphalt and HDPE particles from petrochemical suppliers and manages a comprehensive supply chain including procurement, production, and distribution.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in polymer waterproof materials, focusing on green, durable, and high-performance products aligned with China's dual carbon goals. Key R&D projects include self-adhesive drainage boards, high-strength spray polyurea coatings, fiber-reinforced polymer membranes, and lifecycle photovoltaic roofing systems. It collaborates with universities and research institutes to accelerate innovation and has increased R&D investment steadily over recent years.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of waterproof membranes and coatings, waterproof engineering construction services, and exports. The company employs a sales model dominated by distributors with supplementary direct sales to large real estate and infrastructure clients. Other income includes government subsidies, investment income, and financial services related to receivables.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading high-polymer waterproof material manufacturer in China with strong brand recognition and technological advantages. It competes in a fragmented industry characterized by many small players with varying quality. Jiangsu Canlon differentiates itself through product innovation, quality certifications, and comprehensive service capabilities, aiming to consolidate market share amid industry consolidation trends.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.8 billion, a 31.63% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 22.6 million, recovering from prior losses. Total assets reached RMB 6.52 billion, growing 6.23% from the previous year. The company has shown significant improvement in cash flow and profitability, supported by expanded distribution channels and increased R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Canlon emphasizes high-quality, innovative polymer waterproof materials with superior durability, weather resistance, and environmental compliance. Its products are certified internationally and designed for long lifecycle applications, including specialized solutions for industrial and photovoltaic roofing. The company offers integrated waterproofing systems and technical support, creating value through differentiated products, green manufacturing, and strong brand reputation.
